regional_summary_6h.headline: US‑Iran strikes escalate, Iran vows firm retaliation, energy costs spike
bullets: US completed a second wave of strikes on Iran within 48 hours, striking targets near Hormuz and Jiroft Airport, while Iran responded with drone attacks on a US base in Bahrain.
Iranian officials warned of a firm response after the Sirik attack, heightening immediate escalation risk for the southern border region.
Global oil prices surged above $94 per barrel and European natural‑gas futures hit their highest level since 2023, deepening civilian energy stress across the region.
regional_summary_6h.watch: Watch for Iran's retaliation timing and any spillover strikes affecting regional energy infrastructure.
